deliverable: Stable visible native output HWND during physical rectangle position/size and display-policy changes, with completion-safe backing replacement and window retirement.

ownership.golden_desktop: Public NativeOutputWindow.set_physical_bounds sends bounded value-only commands to the owning per-monitor-v2 thread. SetWindowPos preserves the visible HWND without activation and verifies actual physical client bounds.
ownership.mapgyver: Preparation-host window leases are keyed by project/Screen, independently of renderer sessions. Unchanged GPU bindings preserve the session. New backing extents complete actual old renderer/GPU/Picture retirement before a newly admitted immutable configuration uses the same retained HWND. Session Arc leases protect error/unwind lifetime.
ownership.display_handoff: Explicit allocation_pending distinguishes stale authored/native display metadata from confirmed absence. Pending captures retain existing window identity and wait for revision-driven allocation completion, including an identical resulting cohort. Confirmed absence, disable/removal or project replacement releases windows after all GPU leases retire.
ownership.resize_limit: Backing-size changes conservatively rebuild the renderer session, including other bindings. This gate does not claim stable Spout shared handles or uninterrupted cadence across that replacement. No retained performance/latency requirement is waived.

native.oracle: Every checkpoint: same HWND 2491864, visible, not minimized, exact physical client rectangle, all 25 sampled composited desktop center pixels RGB [255,0,0]. Read-only Python observer filters native Golden output class by owned fixture PID. The app receives public authored operations and actual WebView Undo; no production instrumentation or external window mutation.
native.disable: After disable, all owned output HWNDs disappear following native session retirement. Fixture exits normally 0, no page errors; no owned review app remains.
native.configuration: Actual current OS catalog is external RTK FHD HDR 1920x1080 at (2560,0) and laptop primary 2560x1600 at (0,0). These recorded OS bounds supersede assumptions from the earlier user-reported UHD configuration for this check only; they do not complete the wider physical matrix.
native.scope: Native identity/visibility/bounds and composited pixel checkpoints, corroborated by one lifetime window creation and no hide/replacement path. Not a continuous scanout capture, input-latency measurement, hotplug matrix or final performance qualification.

corrections.fixture_start: Initial fixture attempted native control before frontend navigation completed. It now waits for the real workbench tab before invoking control; no app behavior changed for that failure.
corrections.product_regression: First complete native run passed position/resize/Undo but reproduced HWND replacement on fullscreen reassignment. Current allocation metadata temporarily omitted the new fullscreen route; host mistook it for removal. The explicit pending handoff plus completion wake regression fixes that product defect; unchanged final fixture passes all seven checkpoints.
